Note: The following instructions were created on a machine running Windows 11 and Microsoft Edge Browser.  

Approval Process  

Approval must be provided by the user’s manager unless their manager was the one that submitted the ticket.  

Licensing  

Once approval has been granted, navigate to the IT Software Licensing Teams Group.  

1. If the user is already licensed with an Accubid 16 License, submit request for AVD Only on the AVD channel.  
    

2. If the user needs to be licensed with Accubid 16, submit your request on the Trimble Accubid 16 channel.   Note: There is no need to also submit a request for AVD as we will automatically assign the user a machine.     
    

Security Groups  

Users must be assigned to the following Azure AD Groups   

App Accubid - Provides access to the Network File Share & Remote Desktop   

App Trimble Accubid SSO - Allows login via SSO   

App Accubid Estimators - Mail-enabled security group if the user is an Estimator  

App Accubid Project Managers - Mail-enabled security group if the user is a Project Manager  

App Accubid AVD ACU Users – Allows access to AVD 

Installing Windows App  

Once confirmation of AVD has been assigned, you’ll need to remote into the user’s machine to perform the following steps.  

Step 1: Installation of Remote Desktop  

Navigate to Company Portal and locate the app labeled Microsoft Windows App and click Install  

Step 2: Pin Remote Desktop to Taskbar  

Once the application has been installed, search for Windows App. When you locate it, click the Pin to taskbar option

Step 3: Start Remote Machine  

Click on the recently added Windows App icon you placed on the taskbar. This will open a new window. Click Connect to start the machine  

Note: Prior to starting the machine, confirm with the user how they want their display.  

All Display – The remote desktop will take over all of their screens  

Single Display – The remote desktop will take over one screen. They can move it if they choose to.  

Select Displays – If they want the remote desktop on two adjacent monitors, this is the option you’d choose.  

Step 3a: Set Display Settings  

Once you have confirmed with the user, click the 3-dots and select Settings.  

Toggle Use default settings from On to Off         

Under the Display Settings click the Display configuration dropdown and select the appropriate settings.

Step 4: Dependency Software Installation  

Once the Remote Desktop comes up, open Microsoft Edge and navigate to the following link to install Visual Studio 2010 VC++ 10.0 SP1 x86  

Step 5: Map the A Drive  

Click on File Explorer located on the taskbar and click it to open.  

In File Explorer, locate This PC and right-click it to bring up additional options. Click on Map Network Drive  

On the Map Network Drive window, fill out the according to the setting below and click  

Finish  

|   |
|---|
|Drive Letter: A:  <br><br>Folder Path: \\akzfile.aadds.archkey.com\Accubid <br><br>Reconnect at sign in: Checked|

You will then be prompted to log in for access. Click Finish when done.  

|   |   |
|---|---|
||\|   \|<br>\|---\|<br>\|Username: \<User's UPN>   <br><br>Password: <User's current MS Password>   <br><br>Reconnect at sign-in: Check\||

Step 6: Accubid 16 Pro Configuration  

Locate the Accubid Pro 16 icon on the desktop and double-click it to run.  

Step 6a: JobData Folders  

Setup for Estimators  

Navigate to Settings   

Select Job Folders   

DO NOT USE ANY DEFAULT FOLDERS....Remove anything starting with C:\  Click Add   

 A:\Jobdata\<REGION>\Estimating Department  

Click OK   

Click OK   

Setup for Estimators (ArchKey Sprig)  

Navigate to Settings   

Select Job Folders   

DO NOT USE ANY DEFAULT FOLDERS....Remove anything starting with C:\  Click Add   

1. A:\Accubid Default Jobs\ArchKey SPE (This folder needs to be at the top)  
    

2. A:\Jobdata\ArchKey SPE\Estimating Department\2025   Click OK  Click OK   
    

Setup for Project Managers  

Navigate to Settings   

Select Job Folders   

  

How To Setup AVD and Accubid 16  

DO NOT USE ANY DEFAULT FOLDERS....Remove anything starting with C:\  Click Add   

 A:\Jobdata\<REGION>\Operations\<USERNAME> ( ex. RLeftwich | add M.I. if duplicate name)  

Click OK  Click OK   

Setup for Technologies  

Navigate to Settings   

Select Job Folders   

DO NOT USE ANY DEFAULT FOLDERS....Remove anything starting with C:\  Click Add   

 A:\Jobdata\Technologies\Estimating Department  

Click OK   

Click OK

DO NOT USE ANY DEFAULT FOLDERS....Remove anything starting with C:\   

Click Add   

Enter the name and path of the folder (DO NOT go past the "Legacy" folder)  A:\Database - Elec\Legacy   

Setup for Technologies (Tech)

Select Database Folders   

How To Setup AVD and Accubid 16  

DO NOT USE ANY DEFAULT FOLDERS....Remove anything starting with C:\   

Click Add   

Enter the name and path of the folder (DO NOT go past the "Legacy" folder)  

 A:\Database - Tech  

Click OK   

Click OK   

Step 6c: Additional Option Settings  

Navigate to Settings   

Select Options   

Under General tab – Uncheck Prompt to create database when creating new job   

Under File Locations tab – Place checks in all four boxes and add the appropriate file paths  

1. ArchKey Mona – A:\Screen-Report Styles\East\Styles16  
    

2. ArchKey Parsons – A:\Screen-Report Styles\North Central\Settings  
    

3. ArchKey Sachs – A:\Screen-Report Styles\Central\Styles16  
    

4. ArchKey Sprig – A:\Screen-Report Styles\ArchKey SPE\Styles16  
    

5. ArchKey Technologies – A:\Screen-Report Styles\Tech Under Extension tab – Check the following:  o        Normal, Halted, Equipment, Budget, Normal, Budget, Shop Labor, Quantity totals    Under Database tab – Make sure Multiple Users is selected    Click OK and restart application

Upon starting the application, click Cancel for the Select Project window    

Click on No to use default folder

Step 7c: Additional Option Settings  

Navigate to Settings   

Select Options   

Under General tab – Uncheck Prompt to create database when creating new job  Under Extension tab – Check the following:  o Normal, Halted, Equipment, Budget, Normal, Budget, Shop Labor, Quantity totals   

Under File Locations tab – place a check the three boxes and enter the following in all four cells  

- Technologies o A:\COData\Tech   
    
- ArchKey N. Central / ArchKey Parsons o A:\COData Global File\North Central  
    

Under Database tab – Make sure Multiple Users is selected   

Click OK and restart application
